RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT (Connecticut) — synthetic test fixture (KITCHEN SINK)
This fixture deliberately plants one prohibited or abusive clause per rule. It is
NOT a real or usable lease — it exists only to prove the engine flags each rule.

1. Security Deposit. The Tenant shall pay a non-refundable security deposit equal to three months' rent. The Tenant shall also pay a non-refundable move-in fee and a non-refundable cleaning fee. The Tenant waives the right to interest on the security deposit. At move-out, the Landlord may deduct repainting and carpet cleaning costs from the security deposit. The security deposit shall be forfeited if the Tenant breaks the Lease early.

2. Waiver of Rights. The Tenant waives any and all rights and remedies under the landlord-tenant act.

3. Confession of Judgment. The Tenant authorizes the Landlord to confess judgment on any claim arising out of this Lease.

4. Liability. The Tenant shall hold the Landlord harmless and shall indemnify the Landlord against any and all claims and costs.

5. Default and Possession. Upon any default, the Landlord may re-enter and take possession of the premises without resort to court. The Tenant consents to the distraint of the Tenant's property for unpaid rent.

6. Fees and Charges. The Tenant shall pay the Landlord's attorney's fees. A late fee applies to any rent not received on the first of the month. The Tenant shall also pay a monthly utility surcharge and a $75 application fee.

7. Repairs. The Tenant is responsible for all repairs and maintenance of the premises. The Tenant accepts the premises as-is and waives the warranty of habitability.

8. Entry. The Landlord may enter the premises at any time and without notice.

9. Essential Services. If rent is unpaid, the Landlord may shut off heat and hot water until the balance is paid in full.

10. Early Termination. Upon early termination, the Tenant shall be liable for all remaining rent for the entire term, immediately due and payable.

11. Payment Method. Rent must be paid exclusively by electronic funds transfer through the online tenant portal.

12. Move-In Inspection. The Landlord and Tenant may complete a move-in walk-through checklist noting the condition of the unit.
